name: Goodtime Medical
old_description: Goodtime Medical has been manufacturing and selling directly to customers for over 30 years, delivering commercial-grade medical furniture without middleman markups. We are proudly located just outside St. Louis in Wright City, Missouri.
about:
Goodtime Medical operates from Wright City, Missouri, just outside St. Louis. The company has been manufacturing and selling medical furniture directly to customers for over three decades, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status are not stated.

The company produces a range of commercial-grade medical furniture, including exam tables (family, pro series, pediatric), medical scales (infant, pediatric, jungle), ADA-compliant cabinets and vanities, floating medical cabinets, kitchen and breakroom cabinets, wall cabinets, medical supply carts, and pneumatic medical stools. Manufacturing is done in-house, and products are sold directly without intermediaries. Facility size, headcount, annual volumes, and part-number counts are not published.

Goodtime Medical serves healthcare facilities, clinics, and medical offices that require exam room furniture, ADA-compliant cabinetry, and specialized scales. Customers purchase directly from the manufacturer, which the company says eliminates middleman markups. Specific client names or industry verticals beyond general medical use are not listed.

The company emphasizes its direct-to-customer model and commercial-grade quality as its primary differentiators. It was started to provide medical furniture without the added cost of distributors, offering lead times of two to three weeks with rush-order options available.
